messages:
jamie_sales: Hey team — just got a SIG/CAIQ from AuroraApps, attaching link to PDF: https://files.redwood.example/aurora-CAIQ-2026.pdf
charlie_se: Thanks Jamie. Do we have a dedicated POC for this account?
jamie_sales: Maria is owning the POC, Maria can you confirm timeline? :calendar:
maria_pss: Yep, I'll run the demo next Wed and need answers to the security questionnaire before EOD Tue so customer can move to legal.
lina_security: Uploaded initial triage notes to the ticket. Top blockers: (1) they asked for KMS/HSM details, (2) proof of SOC2 controls for data segregation, (3) routing of telemetry logs to customer's SIEM.
charlie_se: For KMS we have a short snip they can use. Lina can you paste the config excerpt or link?
lina_security: Pasting snippet here:
```
Key management: Customer keys supported via external KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Private deployment supports HSM-backed KEKs and customer-managed rotation.
Contact: security-ops@redwood.com
```
charlie_se: Perfect. I'll put that into the CAIQ response doc.
security-bot: Ticket #SIG-3921 created and assigned to @lina_security. SLA: 72h.
maria_pss: Quick Q on the SOC2 evidence — do we have tenant-level attestations or only org-wide? Customer insists on tenant isolation evidence.
lina_security: We only have org-level SOC2 currently. For tenant isolation we can provide architecture diagrams + config audit logs from Dedicated deployments showing network and ACL separation. I'll attach examples.
jamie_sales: Can we commit to providing those artifacts by Tue EOD? Customer has legal review scheduled Wed morning.
lina_security: I can get diagrams and a sample audit log export by Tue noon. For full managed tenancy proofs we'd need a Dedicated contract, but the docs should satisfy their infosec team for the POC.
maria_pss: Sounds good — I'll tell them we can provide artifacts and a short security runbook for the demo.
charlie_se: One more ask from Aurora: encryption-in-transit ciphers and TLS version. Lina?
lina_security: We support TLS1.2+ and prefer TLS1.3. Cipher list: ECDHE_AESGCM_* families. I'll paste canonical wording in the doc.
maria_pss: Thanks. Also they want a short answer on data retention and delete flows for embeddings.
ina_placeholder: (typo)
charlie_se: @lina_security can we include sample API payload for a delete request and confirm deletion timeline?
lina_security: Yes — typical delete request:
```
DELETE /v1/organizations/{org_id}/embeddings/{id}
Response: 204 No Content
Retention: artifacts removed from primary stores within 24h; full purge from backups within 30 days (documented SLA).
```
lina_security: I'll add that and the SIEM export example.
jamie_sales: Great. Maria — I'll update the customer: we have a security working packet going into your legal queue by Tue noon.
maria_pss: 👍 Please include a named contact (lina_security) and a short blurb about escalation path.
charlie_se: I'll also add a recommended fallback: if they need explicit tenant-level attestation for production, propose Dedicated with a pilot contract.
jamie_sales: Cool. Lina — assigning checklist: CAIQ answers, KMS snippet, SOC2 artifacts (org-level + isolation diagrams), TLS cipher blurb, delete API example, SIEM export. Can you ack when uploaded?
lina_security: Acked — working on it, will upload into the ticket and drop links here when done. ETA Tue 11:30 PT.
maria_pss: Thank you all. If anything slips, ping me and I'll escalate. :handshake:
security-bot: Reminder: SLA for SIG-3921 will expire in 48h unless updated.
jamie_sales: Noted — thanks bot.
charlie_se: Thanks team, closing loop once evidence is attached.
maria_pss: Closing loop — I'll confirm with Aurora after docs arrive.
